headline: When it turns up
lede: Orders leave in two to three business days and ground delivery takes another three to five. US shipping is free over $125, and we ship worldwide.

sections.title: When it leaves
paras: Orders leave the warehouse in two to three business days. Business days, so an order placed on a Friday evening is a Tuesday or Wednesday dispatch.

You get a tracking number as soon as the carrier scans the parcel — which is the moment it is genuinely moving, not the moment the label is printed. A label created and not yet scanned is the most common reason tracking looks stuck on day one.

sections.title: When it lands
paras: Ground delivery takes three to five business days depending on where you are. That is after the two to three days above, not including them.

We ship with USPS, UPS and FedEx. Which one carries your order depends on where it is going and what is in the box. Express — UPS 2 Day — is available to buy at checkout if the ground window is too slow.

sections.title: What it costs
paras: Every US order over $125 ships free. A single wedge is under that, so it carries a charge; two of them do not.
Below $125 the cost is by weight, starting at $8 and rising with the parcel. Express is priced separately at checkout.
Original shipping is not refunded if you return something.

sections.title: Where it ships from, and where it goes
sections.lede: Long Beach, California — and out to most of the world.

tbd.label: Needs confirming
tbd.text: whether duties and import taxes are prepaid at checkout or collected on delivery.
tbd.ask: That is the one number an international order still cannot see in advance, so it is worth asking before you buy.

paras: Orders ship out of Long Beach, with some fulfilment handled from Denver.
International shipping is real and priced by weight: standard service starts at $17.50 for a light parcel and rises with the box. The rate you see at checkout is the rate.

sections.title: Tracking, and when it goes quiet
paras: Tracking updates when the parcel is scanned, so it moves in jumps rather than continuously. A day or two of silence mid-route is normal and usually means it is on a truck between two scans.

Longer than that is worth telling us about. Parcels do get lost, and a lost parcel is our problem to solve rather than yours to chase the carrier over — email support@luckygolf.com with the order number and we will pick it up from there.
sections.note: Two of the reviews on this site describe exactly that: a club lost in transit, and a replacement sent. That is the intended outcome, and asking early is what makes it quick.

sections.nav: If the wrong thing turns up
sections.title: If the wrong thing turns up
paras: A 58 in the box when you ordered a 60 is a picking error, not a return, and it does not come out of your sixty days.
Send us the order number and a photo of what arrived — for a wedge, the loft stamp on the sole settles it in one picture — and do not send anything back until we have replied.

close.headline: Where is it?
close.body: If tracking has stopped moving, or the box turned up with the wrong thing in it, that is worth an email rather than another day of waiting.
close.aside: The order number is in your confirmation email. It saves a whole exchange.

_source: Free shipping: TOTAL_PRICE >= $125.00, US zone. Paid US ground by weight: $8 to 1lb, $18 to 2lb, $25 to 3lb, $35 to 4lb, $40 above. Express (UPS 2 Day): $28 / $40 / $60 by the same weight bands. International 'Rest of the World' Standard Service: $17.50 to 0.5lb rising to $60 at 9lb. Locations: Long Beach CA (two), Compton CA, and a Denver CO fulfilment location.
